source: Bao PLGA corpus only; two derivatives pinned to 605cd707c47a4379212193560cd332d7a2d973fd
duplicates: Average release at identical formulation/time; do not interpolate
grouping: Connected components of shared primary drug identity OR official publication DOI
grouping_limit: No drug group or publication DOI crosses a split. Retrospective single-corpus sensitivity, not external validation.
primary_metric: Mean over formulations of mean absolute error over observed suffix points, multiplied by 100
primary_comparison: rf_amphora minus rf; negative difference favors augmentation
pilot: First fold of first seed, fixed before scoring; full evaluation retains it
fold_assignment: Sort drug group IDs, shuffle with NumPy default_rng(seed), assign round-robin to five folds
training_weights: Each training formulation receives total weight one across its suffix points
preprocessing: Training-fold median imputation and training-fold one-hot encoding with unknown categories ignored
features: Pre-release numeric formulation descriptors and method; first-three times/releases; prefix-derived slopes; query day and elapsed day. Exclude formulation ID, drug SMILES, full duration, final release and future statistics
amphora: Exact existing ranking.py. Two objectives: absolute last-visible-point prediction error after fitting first two points, and complexity (persistence zero; other kinetic families one). Refit all three prefix points and average rank-zero forecasts. RF augmentation adds this mean, front standard deviation and front size
uncertainty: 2000 percentile bootstrap resamples of drug groups after averaging per-formulation losses across repeats; conditional on residual study dependence
invariance: Hold fitted models fixed; perturb only held-out future release labels and require byte-identical features and predictions
analysis_status: Separate exploratory sensitivity declared after primary results; primary protocol and results retained unchanged.
